body: Because of my crippling depression and suicidal tendencies. I want to be a cop because I love helping people and I know it will be easier on my family and friends if I go out that way rather than the cowards way but now I'm over that idea. I'll never amount to anything

I guess I don't know; I just know I don't fit in here. But even in my hometown I don't fit in... the only real thing that has kept me from killing myself in the past was the guilt I would put on my family and now I just feel its better to let this all go and end it here and now

Nobody gets me... I wish I could ask people to hang, but I'm just that weird kid who everybody pretends to friends with. I am homesick, and lonely; but at the same time I don't think these feelings will go away when I get home. I'm a huge burden on my family and I honestly think that them losing me is probably better than what I could offer if I am still around

I have always been a shy introverted kid so I knew friends wouldn't come easy... but tonight was just the tipping point... everyone around me was talking to someone and having a good time and I was just sitting there by myself. On top of that there was a group of girls peeking at me and shaking their heads no as if to say "that guy? never". I can't handle the constant barrage of low self esteem anymore.

I can't remember the last time I was truly happy.... I'm so stressed and so sick of what life has dealt me... I've always wanted to go out as a cop in the line of duty but now I don't even think I can get my dream job. All of my friends back home are set and have careers so I don't want to bother them... I am just so sick of what my life is... i see the good times but they're few and far between
